name: runzivo
description: Create, connect to, check, sleep, wake and delete Runzivo cloud sandboxes from Codex through the rzv CLI.

interface.longDescription: Run work in a Runzivo cloud sandbox: a Linux Firecracker microVM you reach over SSH. Codex creates the sandbox with the size and lifetime you choose, connects to it, shows its status and time left, puts it to sleep and wakes it, and deletes it after you confirm. Everything goes through the open-source rzv CLI and your own Runzivo sign-in. The plugin stores no tokens and calls no API itself. Needs rzv 0.26.0 or later and a Runzivo account.
defaultPrompt: Create a Runzivo sandbox and connect to it
Show my Runzivo sandboxes and their time left
Put my Runzivo sandbox to sleep
